pattern: The existing App Service opb-checkin-api is running in swedencentral with HTTPS-only and TLS 1.2, but publicNetworkAccess is Disabled, so internet requests are rejected before reaching Express.
implication: Reference the existing app as the Front Door origin and use a staged cutover: establish and validate Front Door before applying an origin-only access restriction.

pattern: The existing F1 App Service plan opb-checkin-plan hosts the API and must remain unchanged.
implication: Retain the plan and do not include a deployable App Service plan resource in the additive template.
